purpose: K2 2-thread 200ms retention against paired K4; frozen exploration only

compute.allocation: 11 five-core worker slots, each game narrowed to arm-specific width; 8 slots if who nonempty
compute.release_gate: K-v2 explicit release note plus all PGIDs absent; retain G STOP-03

decision_rules.retention: (loss K0-200 minus loss K2-200)/(loss K0-200 minus loss K4-200)
decision_rules.ci: shared paired-seed percentile bootstrap; denominator<=0 replicas counted and omitted from ratio CI; no claim if point denominator<=0
decision_rules.conclusion: point>=0.8 meets exploratory target; lower95%>=0.8 supports confident retention; upper95%<0.8 rejects target; otherwise uncertainty disclosed

ordering.complete_score: 3 styles at horizon160; no partial or late root eligible
ordering.K4h: h80 used only for ranking; all 3 styles recomputed at160 for refinement
ordering.deadline: full pipeline starts before observation; scoring cutoff = start + deadline - 8ms; no drain, 8ms reserve; OS scheduling residuals measured honestly
ordering.threading: one/two/four persistent private-root GIL-release workers; frozen K-v2 bounded non-draining collector, per-rollout tick cancellation, queued-future cancellation

lateness.play: reserve at decision tick, command due=decision tick+27+overrun_ticks
lateness.wait: wait interval starts at decision tick+overrun_ticks; own poll channel unavailable until then
lateness.opponent: v1 has no search deadline; unchanged cadence
lateness.emulation: deadline sweep preserves 8ms reserve and real-time delay ticks; budget equivalence only, not hardware underclocking
